name: Reliclear
tagline: AI background removal and photo enhance — one tap on Anna.
description: Reliclear removes photo backgrounds with AI (rembg) and enhances clarity and color from one upload. Tries Anna host image.edit first; if platform photo-edit is unavailable, Remove background falls back to local rembg and Enhance falls back to classical local polish. Upload a photo in the App UI, process, preview, and download. Chat tools: enhance_photo and remove_background. Remove object is not included in this release.
